name: Topaz Image Upscale
description: Use the powerful and accurate topaz image enhancer to enhance your images.

action.description: Use the powerful and accurate topaz image enhancer to enhance your images.
action.name: fal-ai/topaz/upscale/image
action.searchText: topaz image upscale  topaz enhance upscale upscaler

creativity.description: Creativity level for generative upscaling. Used by the Redefine and Recovery models.
creativity.title: Creativity

denoise.description: Denoising level applied to the image (0.0-1.0).
denoise.title: Denoise

detail.description: Detail recovery level. Only used by the Recovery V2 model.
detail.title: Detail

face_enhancement.description: Whether to apply face enhancement to the image.
face_enhancement.title: Face Enhancement

face_enhancement_creativity.description: Creativity level for face enhancement. 0.0 means no creativity, 1.0 means maximum creativity. Ignored if face ehnancement is disabled.
face_enhancement_creativity.title: Face Enhancement Creativity

face_enhancement_strength.description: Strength of the face enhancement. 0.0 means no enhancement, 1.0 means maximum enhancement. Ignored if face ehnancement is disabled.
face_enhancement_strength.title: Face Enhancement Strength

image_url.description: URL of the image to be upscaled.
image_url.title: Image URL

model.description: Model to use for image enhancement.
model.title: Model

output_format.description: Output format of the upscaled image.
output_format.title: Output Format

sharpen.description: Sharpening level applied to the image (0.0-1.0).
sharpen.title: Sharpen

strength.description: Enhancement strength. Only used by the Text Refine model.
strength.title: Strength

subject_detection.description: Subject detection mode for the image enhancement.
subject_detection.title: Subject Detection

texture.description: Texture detail level for generative upscaling. Used by the Redefine and Recovery models.
texture.title: Texture

upscale_factor.description: Factor to upscale the video by (e.g. 2.0 doubles width and height)
upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor
